about.description:
pngquant converts 24/32-bit RGBA PNG images to 8-bit palette images with
an alpha channel, typically reducing file size by 60-80% while remaining
fully standards-compliant and readable by every PNG decoder. Quantization
is performed by libimagequant.

As of pngquant 3.x the command-line tool is built with Rust (the image
quantization core and PNG I/O remain C, linked in via imagequant-sys and
libpng-sys).
about.summary: Lossy PNG compressor — converts 24/32-bit PNGs to efficient 8-bit palette images with alpha

script.content:
tar xzf pngquant-${{ version }}.tar.gz
cd pngquant-${{ version }}
cargo auditable install --locked --no-track --bins --root "${PREFIX}" --path .
cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output ../THIRDPARTY.yml
cp COPYRIGHT ..

raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "3.0.3"

package:
  name: pngquant
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  # crates.io, NOT the GitHub tag archive. Upstream keeps imagequant-sys as a
  # git SUBMODULE at lib/imagequant-sys and Cargo.toml declares it as a path
  # dependency
  url: https://static.crates.io/crates/pngquant/pngquant-${{ version }}.crate
  sha256: 68a12bdd8825f9989f4ee9a6ab0b42727dae57728b939ef63453366697a07232
  file_name: pngquant-${{ version }}.tar.gz

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    env:
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
      PYTHONUTF8: "1"
      PKG_CONFIG_ALLOW_CROSS: "1"
    content:
      # Canonical conda-forge Rust CLI pattern: cargo auditable install with
      # --locked --no-track --bins, split install root per platform.
      - if: unix
        then: |
          tar xzf pngquant-${{ version }}.tar.gz
          cd pngquant-${{ version }}
          cargo auditable install --locked --no-track --bins --root "${PREFIX}" --path .
          cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output ../THIRDPARTY.yml
          cp COPYRIGHT ..
        else: |
          tar xzf pngquant-${{ version }}.tar.gz
          cd pngquant-${{ version }}
          cargo auditable install --locked --no-track --bins --root %LIBRARY_PREFIX% --path .
          cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output ..\THIRDPARTY.yml
          copy COPYRIGHT ..

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
    - cargo-auditable
    - pkg-config
  host:
    # libpng-sys and lcms2-sys link the system libraries via pkg-config;
    # the `lcms2` feature is on by default.
    - libpng
    - lcms2
    - zlib

tests:
  - script:
      - pngquant --version
      - if: unix
        then:
          - test -x "${PREFIX}/bin/pngquant"
        else:
          - if not exist "%LIBRARY_BIN%\pngquant.exe" exit 1

about:
  homepage: https://pngquant.org/
  repository: https://github.com/kornelski/pngquant
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file:
    - COPYRIGHT
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  summary: Lossy PNG compressor — converts 24/32-bit PNGs to efficient 8-bit palette images with alpha
  description: |
    pngquant converts 24/32-bit RGBA PNG images to 8-bit palette images with
    an alpha channel, typically reducing file size by 60-80% while remaining
    fully standards-compliant and readable by every PNG decoder. Quantization
    is performed by libimagequant.

    As of pngquant 3.x the command-line tool is built with Rust (the image
    quantization core and PNG I/O remain C, linked in via imagequant-sys and
    libpng-sys).

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - izahn
    - rxm7706
